findings.closure: One exact seven-environment registry preserves all five required AT combinations and two separate desktop keyboard-only passes; omissions, substitutions, duplicates, and unversioned components reject.

The oracle validates 2,664,900 checkpoint keys and exact raw digest plus signed batch, verified identity, current DHS Trusted Tester qualification, platform-pod assignment, exact targets, and independent provider proof; actual Gate 3 manual evidence remains future human work.

All 16 lifecycle classes consume a complete HUMAN-AUTHORITY graph and, for raw data, a composed RAW-POLICY-GRANT; protected requests, authoritative replay/CAS, exact multi-copy inventory, registry-selected provider receipts, aggregates and tombstones are independently verified. Exact provider registry metadata and key validity are checked at signing and evaluation time; malformed/substituted authority, registry, key, target, policy, inventory, race and crash paths fail closed.

Closed migration evidence executes 3,614 rows with independently recomputed signed schema, reader, writer, rollback, checkpoint, recovery-source and transition state. Recovery and restore are distinct transitions with pinned unequal inputs/results, while destructive contract cleanup consumes a complete human-authority graph bound to exact plan, backup, columns, operations and tenants.
Both validator modes bind the immutable source target with git-show bytes, execute all irreversible matrices, and do not assert the obsolete predecessor digest.

The v3 human-authority envelope byte-compares governing policies and verifies distinct authority/provider/replay/CAS signatures plus identity, qualification, assignment, session, target, inventory and destructive conditions; historical rulings remain immutable but cannot satisfy the new envelope.
Exact-revision fixtures-only and full validation use immutable Git target bytes and execute the human-authority and lifecycle matrices.

Spend validation enforces a null-predecessor root, exact cumulative successor transitions, bounded nonnegative infrastructure/model amounts at five scopes, UTC period and currentness. Dedicated replay-authority and cas-authority records bind immutable request bytes/digest, idempotency, target, policy, winner/result and current-head lineage; missing, stale, drifted or ordinary-signer evidence denies.

Forecast, invoice and reconciliation derive from signed provider price, actual usage and immutable invoice bytes plus closed authorization/usage/invoice/ledger/variance/successor lineage. Exact duplicate-free multiplicity and complete equality of ledger, provider-usage and provider-invoice sets are enforced; reordered complete sets pass while duplicate, missing, substituted, orphaned, stale or forked evidence denies.
The exact-target validator executes and proves declared-versus-executed monetary case equality without predecessor Exam coupling.

Exactly 20 prompts derive equivalence-class size and linkage from a frozen authorized 100-row pool; no prompt k claim is trusted. Detector coverage includes digit-only, extension, `+` and `00` international non-US phone formats and Unicode isolate/embedding/mark evasions, while sixteen-digit, embedded and short boundaries remain non-matches.

Provider-native recovery uses separated provider/verifier anchors and executes eight loss cuts plus twenty-five corruptions. Authority and nested records bind exact cut, corruption class, provider, tenant, item, target/implementation revisions and policy; generic proof, opaque identity, arbitrary policy and scope substitutions fail closed while exact decision/Git bytes, retry identity and measured RTO are verified.
Historical round-two target verification now reads declared Git-object bytes; round-three validation binds immutable source bytes in both modes.

The v12 manifest binds exact target and authorization-policy bytes/digest across every relevant record. Closed current replay/CAS records use dedicated trust domains with exact request/idempotency/head bindings; all seventeen private signing domains are unavailable to public callers, and lifecycle provider metadata is independently anchored and time-evaluated.

humanBoundary.reason: An agent cannot create or infer the new qualified-human ruling required over a future incorporated Exam/policy revision.
